## Build options and test registration (`cmake -DNAME=value`) {#sec-ch12-build}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **see table**. Set build options during CMake configuration. `BUILD_TESTS=ON`, `FULL_TESTS=OFF` and `CUDA=OFF` are the defaults.
Registration, enablement and execution are separate states; a registered CUDA test is not evidence of a CUDA run.
There is no numerical order for a build selector.
:::

| option or cache value | default | effect and coupling |
|---|---|---|
| `BUILD_TESTS` | ON | enters the tests subdirectory |
| `FULL_TESTS` | OFF | adds long reference/decomposition cases |
| `BUILD_EXAMPLES` | OFF | ineffective: examples subdirectory is unconditional |
| `CUDA` | OFF | enables CUDA compilation; with UCX needs the commux CUDA sidecar |
| `NETCDF` | ON | requires NetCDF and emits output macro |
| `UCX`, `PNETCDF` | ON except Apple OFF | require commux/UCX headers and Python pinc respectively |
| `NMASS` | 0 | legacy mass-index offset; positive values fail the static index assertion |
| `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE` | Release | GNU/Clang Release optimisation or Debug sanitizers |
| `SNAPY_TEST_PYTHONPATH` | empty | prepends the intended package to Python test imports |
| `KINTERA_DATA_DIR` | unset | supplies the test nasa9.dat symlink |
| `EIGEN`, `FMT`, `GTEST`, `YAML-CPP` | ON in package calls | dependency fetching and cached archives |

The CUDA architecture list starts at 60, 61, 70, 75, 80, 86, 89; toolkit 12 adds 90, 12.8 adds 120,
and 13 removes 60, 61 and 70. The Torch ABI probe supplies the global C++ ABI definition.


### Derivation

No continuum or discrete equation is selected here. The dependency chain is configure, generate, compile, register,
then execute. `BUILD_TESTS=OFF` stops before registration; a non-CUDA build disables matching GPU entries after registration.
These are configuration predicates, not a convergence derivation.

### Numerical method

Build flags act before any mesh or RK stage exists. Test names use the lower-case build type suffix, represented here by `<b>`.
The Python import-path probe must run before numerical Python evidence can be attributed to this checkout.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-build-flow
#| fig-cap: "Build options and test registration: labelled boxes show inputs and decisions in evaluation order. This is a configuration or stencil diagram, not measured data."
#| fig-alt: "CMake options; generated definitions; register tests; enable or disable; execute separately."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch12.fig_build_flow import make_fig
make_fig()
```

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
No configure/build is run for this draft. `BUILD_EXAMPLES`, positive `NMASS` and `NETCDF=OFF` have no dedicated test here.
The Torch/package/toolchain combination still needs a CPU configure smoke test before claiming build compatibility.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
